contained within EXP, innermost ones first."* So in `(r >> 12) * f(x)` the CALL
is emitted before either operand, and the shift lands **after** it. The load
therefore has to be its own statement to stay before the call, which is exactly
what the target has: `lw` pre-call, `sra` post-call.

| spelling | words | differing |
|---|---|---|
| `r = a->unk_0C;` then `(r >> 12) * f(...)` inline, twice | 63 | **0** |
| `r = a->unk_0C >> 12;` as its own statement, then `r * f(...)` twice | 63 | **12** |

**Why the allocation follows.** With the shift inline, cse1 unifies the two
`r >> 12` and `combine_regs` ties the shift's quantity to the load's. That
merged quantity has 5 refs against the other local's 3 over a *shorter* range,
so `QTY_CMP_PRI` (`local-alloc.c:1693-1695`,
`floor_log2 (n_refs) * n_refs * size / (death - birth)`) sorts it first and it
takes the low register. Split as a separate statement, the shift is born
*before* the call, its live range is longer, and the other local wins the low
register instead.

**Fingerprint, and it is specific: a candidate at the RIGHT LENGTH whose only
differences are a two-register swap PLUS a different insn in a `jal`'s delay
slot, in a function where a product has a call on one side.** Do not permute
the declarations -- move the split in the statement. The 12 differing words
here were exactly that: `$s0`/`$s1` exchanged, and the `jal`'s delay slot
carrying the `sra` instead of the argument copy.

### AN INTERIOR POINTER MUST BE ONE C VARIABLE WITH ITS BASE, OR IT COSTS A REGISTER OR VANISHES

Same family, `func_800BB894` (129 words). The target's `addiu $s1, $s1, 0x20`
writes the actor view back into the **node's own register**, which is `o++` on
an `UnkNode *` whose `sizeof` is 0x20 -- the `n + 1` payload idiom
`include/structs.h` already records for `Unk44144`.

| spelling | words | differing |
|---|---|---|
| `o++` on the `UnkNode *`, before the gate | 129 | **0** |
| separate `u8 *v = (u8 *)o + 0x20;` | 129 | 2 (the view takes its own register) |
| the same, taken later | 130 | 43 (combine folds the add into a displacement and the word VANISHES) |
| `o++` taken after the gate | 128 | 43 |

The last row is `reorg` stealing the increment into the gate's delay slot from
two insns back (`reorg.c:3067-3077`), so it has to be written *before* the
branch.

**A falsified draft worth keeping, because it is the right way to check this
class.** The agent first assumed that delay-slot `addiu` was stolen from the
branch TARGET block. The displacement settles it: the branch encodes an offset
that lands on the first insn of the target block, so nothing was taken from
there and the branch was not retargeted -- which is what proves the add sits
before the branch in source. **Decode the branch offset before assuming which
side of a branch a delay-slot insn came from.**

## A 16-BIT WINDOW MUST BE A `(u16)` CAST, NOT AN `& 0xFFFF` MASK -- SAME WORD COUNT, 32 DIFFERING

Measured on `func_800A8EE8`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03. The function landed at
284/284 with 0 differing; the masked spelling is **also 284 words** and
**32 differing**. There is no size signal at all, which is what makes this
worth a lever: a near-miss that looks like an allocation or scheduling problem
and is really a typing one.

An on-screen test over a projected `DVECTOR`, sixteen times:

    if ((u16)(pt.vx + 0x20) < 0x181)        /* lhu + sltiu : RIGHT */
    if (((pt.vx + 0x20) & 0xFFFF) < 0x181)  /* lh  + slti  : WRONG */

The cast makes the whole expression `unsigned short`-typed, so the load is
`lhu` and the comparison `sltiu`. The mask leaves it `int` -- `& 0xFFFF` is an
arithmetic operation on an `int`, not a change of type -- so the load stays
`lh` and the comparison `slti`. **Two words per predicate, sixteen predicates,
32 differing, and the word count is identical because the instruction COUNT is
identical.** Only the opcodes move.

The existing narrowing levers do not cover this. The MEM_IN_STRUCT_P cast
lever is about which cast makes a field reference a struct reference, and the
`<< k` / `* (1 << k)` lever above is about an operation that changes a load's
signedness as a side effect. This one is the plain statement that **a mask is
not a cast for the purposes of the comparison's signedness**, and it is cheap
to get wrong because both spellings read as "take the low 16 bits".

How to spot it without guessing: the opcode pair `lh`/`slti` against
`lhu`/`sltiu` is visible in the listing, and `--raw` arithmetic will NOT close
on it, because neither word carries a relocation. A residue that is an exact
multiple of the number of predicates is the tell.

## THE `addPrim` MACRO VS THE REAL CALL IS A PER-SITE QUESTION, AND A NEIGHBOUR'S RECORDED ANSWER DOES NOT TRANSFER

Measured on `func_800A8EE8`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03. The function links a
`POLY_G4` with the inline `addPrim` macro -- psyq's
`setaddr(p, getaddr(ot)); setaddr(ot, p)` over the 24-bit `P_TAG.addr`
bitfield, which is where the `0xFFFFFF` / `0xFF000000` immediate pair comes
from (`psyq/include/libgpu.h:236/241/246`) -- and links the trailing `DR_MODE`
with the real `func_8006658C` call. **Both forms in one function.**

Spelling the `POLY_G4` link as the call instead is **252 words against 284,
208 differing**: the macro is worth 32 words here, so this is not a subtle
lever, but it IS easy to get backwards, because `func_800A1354`'s own recorded
comment says the macro form measured 315 against a 300-word target and the
call was right for IT. A nearby function's recorded diagnosis of this
did not transfer.

**What settles it off the listing, in one command:** count the `jal`s per
region. Five `jal`s per half with only ONE `func_8006658C` among them means one
of the two links is inline. Do that before writing either form.

## A `(u32)` CAST ON A STRUCT FIELD STORE RESTORES THE sched1 DEPENDENCE THAT `MEM_IN_STRUCT_P` CANCELS -- AND IT CAN FIX AN UNRELATED sched2 TIE TWO WORDS AWAY

Measured on `func_800BC574`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03. Worth **4 differing at the
correct 86 words**, so it reads as an allocation problem: the residue is one
sunk store plus one wrong register.

The shape is a store to a struct field immediately followed by a load from the
same symbol's region:

    d->unk_00 = (u32)D_800F15E4;               /* WRONG: load hoists above it */
    d->unk_08 = *(u32 *)(D_800F15E4 + 4);

    *(u32 *)d = (u32)D_800F15E4;               /* RIGHT: dependence survives  */
    d->unk_08 = *(u32 *)(D_800F15E4 + 4);

The target stores first and the load **reuses the address register**:

    0114 ae430000 sw   v1,0(s2)
    0118 8c630004 lw   v1,4(v1)

With the named field the load hoists above the store, so the symbol's register
stays live and the loaded word needs a second one.

**Why.** `scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/sched.c:854-861`, inside
`true_dependence`, CANCELS a conflict `memrefs_conflict_p` has already
reported:

          && ! (MEM_IN_STRUCT_P (mem) && rtx_addr_varies_p (mem)
                && GET_MODE (mem) != QImode
                && GET_CODE (XEXP (mem, 0)) != AND
                && ! MEM_IN_STRUCT_P (x) && ! rtx_addr_varies_p (x))

`mem` is the store: `MEM_IN_STRUCT_P` set because it is a `COMPONENT_REF`,
address varying because it is a pseudo, SImode, not an `AND`. `x` is the load:
flag clear, address constant. Every conjunct holds, the dependence is thrown
away, and sched1 may hoist. Spelling the store `*(u32 *)d` or
`*(u32 *)((u8 *)d + 0x0)` clears `MEM_IN_STRUCT_P` on `mem`, the first conjunct
fails, the second needs `MEM_IN_STRUCT_P (x)` which is 0, and the dependence
survives. Three raw-cast spellings reach 0 (the `+0x00` store alone, both
stores, and a `u8 *d` with every field raw-cast); only the named field fails.

**This is the OTHER direction of the same clause** that `func_80096C3C`'s
landing used (where the fix was to CLEAR the flag so a global byte read would
stop conflicting with a run of struct stores). Same four conditions, read from
the store side instead of the load side. If a store and a nearby load are in
the wrong order, check which of the two carries the flag before touching
statement order -- the order may not be reachable from source at all.

**The reusable surprise.** That one-token change also fixed an unrelated pair
two words away, where the candidate put a call's `$a0` copy ahead of another
symbol's `%hi` -- the sched2 LUID tie at `:16225`. The LUID shift from the
earlier statement resolved it with **no `register`-pin-plus-`__asm__`-fence
device at all**, which is that lever's own stated cheaper corollary (look at
what the surrounding code does to the tie before reaching for the device),
now confirmed on a third function.

## A DIVISION USED AS A TRUTH VALUE STAYS A DIVISION WHEN ITS QUOTIENT IS LIVE DOWNSTREAM

Measured on `func_800AF8B0`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03. `i / 5 != 0` as a gate,
with `i / 5` also feeding the row, is 47 words and 0 differing; rewriting the
gate as `if (i >= 5)` is **48 words and 32 differing**. The comparison looks
like the cheaper spelling of the same question and is not: the quotient is
needed anyway, so the division is real and the gate costs nothing extra, while
the comparison adds a test the target does not have and perturbs everything
after it. Check whether the quotient is live before "simplifying" a division
into a comparison.

Companion measurement from the same function, on the SAME 47 words: the
if/else, the ternary `i / 5 ? 0x28 : -0xB4`, the explicit `!= 0` ternary and a
separate `row` local all reach 0, while INVERTING the test so the `-0xB4` arm
comes first is 3 differing -- the delay-slot value is the branch-TAKEN one.

## ONE OF 24 STORE ORDERS, AND THE READER'S ORDER IS NOT IT -- A FOUR-STORE LEAF IS WORTH AN EXHAUSTIVE SWEEP

Measured on `func_800B0134`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03: 9 words, four stores, all
24 permutations compiled. Exactly **one** order is 0 differing, and the order a
reader would write (the fields in ascending offset) is **3 differing** --
`li $v0, 1` gets scheduled ahead of the first store. The distribution is worth
knowing because it shapes the search: 1 order at 0, four at 3, one at 4, two at
5, one at 6, two at 7, thirteen at 8. So a plateau at 3 on a small leaf is one
swap away from 0, and a plateau at 8 is nowhere near it.

At 24 compiles this is cheaper than reasoning about it, and the same is true at
720 (`func_800B6FB8`) and 840 (`func_8009D424`). **Sweep a small leaf's store
order exhaustively rather than permuting by hand** -- and read the FLOOR: on
`func_8009D424` all 840 orders bottomed out at 8, which is what proved the
answer was not an ordering at all.

## A NARROW RETURN TYPE ON A NEWLY LANDED FUNCTION IS A CALLER-SIDE HAZARD -- THE CALLEE IS IDENTICAL EITHER WAY

Measured on `func_800AB030`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03. This is the mirror of the
arity hazard the sweep's checklist already covers in both directions, and the
checklist says nothing about the return type.

`func_800AB030`'s closing `sll 16` / `sra 16` reads as an `s16` return, and
spelling it that way is **the same 21 words at 0 differing**:

    s16 func_800AB030(UnkTownActor *a)   /* callee: 21/0 -- looks right */
    s32 func_800AB030(UnkTownActor *a)   /* callee: 21/0 -- identical  */
        ... return (s16)(...);

But it is defined ABOVE its two LANDED callers, so the narrow prototype becomes
visible to them, and gcc then sign-extends `$v0` after the `jal` before using
it: **func_800AB5C0 goes 82/0 -> 82/2 and func_800AB708 goes 61/0 -> 61/13.**
The `s32` return with an explicit `(s16)` cast on the returned expression
produces byte-identical callee output and leaves both callers at 0.

**So the callee cannot tell you its own return width when the narrowing is the
last thing it does.** Only its callers can, and if they are already landed the
only thing that sees the regression is the whole-unit sweep -- which is why the
sweep has to cover the unit and not just the functions you touched. A landed
caller's regression is invisible to `ovlverify` on your own targets, invisible
to `make` (it still links and the container is still the right length when the
word count does not change), and visible only as a nonzero in the sweep.

Reported as a measurement rather than a mechanism: nobody has read
`expand_call`/`convert_to_mode` to confirm WHY, and the agent that found it
declined to claim a cause it had not read. The companion fact, from
`func_8008C214` the same day, is the parameter-side twin: **a narrow
PARAMETER's width is witnessed in the caller too** -- `s16` for its first
parameter is 30/0 in the callee and takes its caller from 11/0 to 14 words and
12 differing.

## A DISPATCH CALL THROUGH A SLOT CAN BE A TIE ACROSS ARITY, SO THE CALL SITE CANNOT WITNESS ITS OWN ARGUMENT COUNT

Measured on `func_800A78AC`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03. `a->unk_50()` and
`a->unk_50(a, b, c)` are **0 differing both ways**, because `a`, `b` and `c`
are already in `$a0`/`$a1`/`$a2` at the `jalr` and the three-argument form's
copies are no-op sets that get deleted.

`-da` dumps locate the deletion: three argument-register sets survive to
`.greg` and one to `.jump2`, i.e. it happens in reload, where
`reload_cse_regs` (`reload1.c:2140`) tests `reload_cse_noop_set_p` (`:8049`,
via `reload_cse_regno_equal_p` at `:8022`). `$a1`'s copy goes one pass
earlier, at local-alloc.

The consequence is worth stating plainly, because it is the opposite of the
usual reading: **a `jalr` through a slot with no argument setup is not evidence
of a zero-argument call, and neither is one WITH argument setup evidence of a
three-argument call.** The sweep doc records that a missing argument move is
not evidence; this is the same fact from the other side, with the measurement.
Arity for a slot-dispatched handler comes from the dispatcher's own cast, not
from any call site.

## THE PARENTHESISATION OF AN INTEGER SUM ADDED TO A POINTER IS DECIDED IN THE C FRONT END, AND IT FIRES ON THE PARENTHESISED FORM

Measured on `func_800B1B70`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03: **4 words and 30 differing**
between `v + (i * 0x10 + K)` and `v + i * 0x10 + K`.

`pointer_int_sum` (`scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/c-typeck.c:2621`) says at
`:2648-2651` that when the integer operand "contains a constant term, apply
distributive law and multiply that constant term separately... This helps
produce common subexpressions". The guard at `:2653-2656` is
`(TREE_CODE (intop) == PLUS_EXPR || ... MINUS_EXPR) && ! TREE_CONSTANT (intop)
&& TREE_CONSTANT (TREE_OPERAND (intop, 1)) && TREE_CONSTANT (size_exp)`, and
the body at `:2674-2676` rewrites the pointer to `ptrop + operand 1` with
`intop` reduced to operand 0.

So `v + (i * 0x10 + K)` becomes `(v + K) + i * 0x10`: a base of `v + K`, which
is **distinct** from the four stores' own `v + i * 0x10`, so three separate
0x10-stride registers survive strength reduction. Left-associated, the outer
add's `intop` is a *constant*, `! TREE_CONSTANT (intop)` rejects it, the tree
keeps the source's `v + i * 0x10` subexpression, one giv serves everything and
the stored pointers become `addiu`s off it.

Three ways to miss the block, all measured on the same function: parenthesised
0 differing, left-associated 27 words / 30 differing, and the integer sum
hoisted into a local 31 / 13 (operand 1 is then a `VAR_DECL`, not constant).

**Two plausible mechanisms were falsified first and are worth knowing as
non-causes**: `loop.c`'s `combine_givs` (`:5738-5757`, two givs combine only
when `mult_val` *and* `add_val` are `rtx_equal_p`) is a real rule but the bases
already differ before `loop.c` runs; and `fold-const.c`'s `associate:` arg1 arm
(`:4257-4283`) does rewrite `ARG0 + (CON + VAR)` into `(ARG0 + CON) + VAR`, but
`split_tree` strips only mode-preserving conversions (`:1001-1006`) and the
front-end block has already consumed the pattern. A statement boundary does
NOT prevent this one, which is how it differs from the `fold` re-association
levers above.

## `abs()` ON MIPS IS ONE RTL INSN, AND WHETHER IT COSTS 2 OR 3 WORDS IS AN ALLOCATION FACT, NOT A TREE SHAPE

A correction to the `expand_abs` lever above. `abs()` does **not** expand to a
copy plus a branch at tree-expand time on this target: it expands to one insn,
`82 {abssi2}`, which `sched.py --insn N` shows directly. `expand_abs`
(`optabs.c:2152`) is only reached when the target has no abs pattern, and MIPS
has one.

The copy/branch/`negu` triple comes from the pattern's **output template**,
which branches on the allocator's result:

> `scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/config/mips/mips.md:1766` `(define_insn "abssi2" ...)`
> `:1776` `if (REGNO (operands[0]) == REGNO (operands[1]))`
> `:1781` `return "bgez\t%1,1f%#\n\tsubu\t%0,%z2,%0\n1:";` -- 2 words, in place
> `:1784` `return "%(bgez\t%1,1f\n\tmove\t%0,%1\n\tsubu\t%0,%z2,%0\n1:%)";` -- 3 words

So the question is only whether the allocator gave the abs its source's hard
register, i.e. whether the source **dies** at the abs. `func_80094DA8` shows
BOTH forms from one plain `abs()` spelling: the field's load dies, so the
in-place 2-word form with a `bgez` + `nop`; `dx`/`dy` are live past the
comparison, so the 3-word form, whose `move` reorg steals into the `bgez`'s
delay slot.

The older lever's empirical conclusion stands -- a ternary into its own
variable versus in place changes exactly whether the source dies -- but its
citation chain and its "tree shape" framing are wrong for MIPS, and the
practical consequence is that **the lever is reachable from a plain `abs()`
with no ternary at all**.

## A COMPARISON'S WRITTEN OPERAND ORDER FIXES THE RTL INSN NUMBERING OF BOTH OPERANDS, WHICH SETS A REGISTER PAIR AND ONE LOAD'S SCHEDULING SLOT

Measured on `func_80094DA8`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03: **16 of 108 words.**
`abs(dx) < abs(b->unk_0C)` and `abs(b->unk_0C) > abs(dx)` are the same
predicate and produce the same `slt`, and they are not interchangeable.

`do_jump`'s `GT_EXPR` arm passes the tree to `compare()` **unswapped**
(`scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/expr.c:10590-10596`; the swap that turns a GT
into an `slt` is the backend's, later), and `compare()` expands operand 0
strictly first (`:10948-10951`).

`sched.py --insn N` on both spellings, same block (`basic block number 1 from
45 to 54`, 8 cycles in both):

* landed `abs(field) > abs(dx)`: insn **49** = the field's `lw`, **50** =
  `(set (reg v1) (abs (reg v1)))`, **51** = `(set (reg v0) (abs (reg s1)))`
* rejected `abs(dx) < abs(field)`: insn **48** = `(set (reg v1) (abs (reg s1)))`,
  **50** = the field's `lw`, **51** = `(set (reg v0) (abs (reg v0)))`

Two consequences, both visible in the 8 differing words per half: the
later-numbered abs gets `$v0` and the earlier `$v1`, so the pair swaps; and the
dependence chains change enough that sched1 hoists the field's `lw` above the
`sll` in one and not the other (`;; ready list at T-6: 49` against `46`). A
second, different payout for the operand-order lever above -- there it decided
a block's first insn, here a register pair plus a load's slot.

## `memrefs_conflict_p` TREATS TWO CONSTANT-OFFSET MEMs ASYMMETRICALLY BY BASE REGISTER, WHICH SAYS WHICH STORE PERMUTATIONS WERE EVEN REACHABLE

Measured on `func_80098834`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03, where the target's
**emitted** store order is not the source order.

In `scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/sched.c`:

* **Same base register, different constant offsets -> NO conflict.**
  `:702-703` is `if (rtx_equal_for_memref_p (x0, y0)) return
  memrefs_conflict_p (xsize, x1, ysize, y1, c);`, which lands on `:770-775`,
  two `CONST_INT`s, `c += (INTVAL (y) - INTVAL (x))` -- zero overlap at
  HImode sizes for 0x30 against 0x10.
* **Different base registers -> ALWAYS conflict.** `:704-707` folds the offset
  difference into `c` and recurses on the two bare REGs, which match neither
  the PLUS, MULT nor `CONSTANT_P` arms and fall through to `return 1` at
  `:797`. There is no `base_alias_check` in this gcc.

Consequence, measured: the `+0x10` load *through `a`* **can** hoist over the
`+0x30` store *through `a`*, so writing the statements in the target's emitted
order (`+0x30, +0xE, +0x32`) lets sched2 fill the first load-delay slot and the
target's `nop` disappears -- 13 words, 6 differing. But the `+0x6` load
*through `b`* **cannot** cross the `+0xE` store *through `a`*, so its position
pins the source order. The only order reproducing both facts is
**`+0x30, +0x32, +0xE`**.

So when an exhaustive store-order sweep is in play, this rule says which
permutations the compiler could even distinguish -- a cheaper question than
running all of them. **`MEM_IN_STRUCT_P` is irrelevant here and was falsified
as the explanation first**: `true_dependence`'s two guard clauses (`:854-861`)
each require `! rtx_addr_varies_p` on one side, and every address in this
function is `(plus (reg) (const))`, so both clauses are dead.

## reorg COPIES A LOOP HEAD IT DOES NOT OWN INTO THE BACK BRANCH'S DELAY SLOT, SO THE COUNTER ADJUSTMENT MUST BE A STATEMENT INSIDE THE BREAK ARM

Measured on `func_800A20D8`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03: the placement of one `i++`
is the whole four-word gap. The target reads:

```
word  8  addu  $s0, $a3, $zero      # the parameter's own copy
word 16  addiu $s0, $s0, -0x1       # the loop HEAD, executed on fall-in
.L800A211C:                          # <- the branch target, PAST word 16
word 28  bnez  $s0, .L800A211C
word 29  addiu $s0, $s0, -0x1       # delay slot: a COPY of word 16
word 30  addiu $s0, $s0, 0x1        # undoes word 29 on the fall-through
word 31  addu  $v0, $s0, $zero
```

The decrement appears twice and the fall-through carries a compensating `+1`.
Two spellings that look equivalent and cannot reach it:

* `i = d - 1` folded into the init, with `i--` removed from the loop: 40 words,
  27 differing. The target *needs* `i = d;` as a copy and `i--` as the loop
  head.
* `return i + 1;` after the loop: 40 / 18, because that computes the return
  value once per exit instead of adjusting `$s0` and sharing one
  `addu $v0, $s0, $zero`.

The spelling that reaches 42 / 0 is `i = d; do { i--; ...; if (hit) { i++;
break; } } while (i != 0); return i;` -- the adjustment as a statement
**inside the break arm**, with a bare `return i;` tail. A `goto` back-edge is
not needed and was a false positive for this function.

## A COMPOUND ASSIGNMENT TO A NARROW FIELD IS ABOUT `+=` VERSUS THE WRITTEN-OUT FORM, NOT ABOUT OPERAND ORDER

Refines the `fold`-associate lever above with a priced measurement on
`func_800A5A98`, ovl_town, 2026-11-03.

`g->unk_C8 -= 0x10 + d` gives the target's `addiu $v0, $v0, -0x10` then
`subu $v0, $v0, $s0`, i.e. `(C8 - 0x10) - d`: the compound assignment's arg0 is
a NOP_EXPR across the HImode widening, so `split_tree` declines and `fold`
takes the arg1 arm, leaving the constant on the inside. Written out as
`g->unk_C8 = g->unk_C8 - 0x10 - d` it builds `C8 + (d + K)` and measures
**215 words / 47 differing** -- a word SHORTER and badly wrong.

Writing the operands the other way round *inside* the compound (`-= d + 0x10`)
is byte-identical, because `fold` canonicalises the constant last either way.
So the lever is `+=` against the written-out form; operand order within the
compound is free.

## A 4 x `u8` RECORD CANNOT HAVE SImode, SO A 4-BYTE GLOBAL THAT MOVES IN ONE `lw`/`sw` IS NOT A RECORD TYPE

Measured on the `func_8009F77C` group, ovl_town, 2026-11-04, and it settles two
spellings in OPPOSITE directions from one rule.

`layout_type`'s `RECORD_TYPE` arm in
`scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/stor-layout.c` keeps BLKmode whenever the known
alignment is below what the scalar mode would need:

```c
	  /* If structure's known alignment is less than
	     what the scalar mode would need, and it matters,
	     then stick with BLKmode.  */
	  if (STRICT_ALIGNMENT
	      && ! (TYPE_ALIGN (type) >= BIGGEST_ALIGNMENT
		    || (TYPE_ALIGN (type)
			>= TREE_INT_CST_LOW (TYPE_SIZE (type)))))
```

A 4-byte record of `u8` fields has `TYPE_ALIGN` 8, which is neither
`BIGGEST_ALIGNMENT` (64) nor `>= TYPE_SIZE` (32), so it is BLKmode with
alignment 1 and every copy goes through `emit_block_move`.

The two consequences:

* **`D_80100AA0` must be `extern s32 []`.** Its shift loop is ONE `lw`/`sw`
  pair, which a BLKmode record cannot produce, and `func_800A03DC`'s
  `sw $zero` has no record spelling at all.
* **`D_8008910C`'s `lwl`/`lwr` + `swl`/`swr` copy is the SAME rule from the
  other side** -- that is `emit_block_move` on an alignment-1 4-byte object,
  i.e. `u8 s[4]; memcpy(s, <rodata>, 4);` with the source declared
  `extern u8 ...[]`.

So on any 4-byte-record family in this unit, the instruction that moves the
object tells you which spelling it is, and the "try a record view" branch can
be skipped.

## reorg's DELAY-SLOT THREAD CHOICE IS WORTH A WORD, AND THE SOURCE CONTROL IS WHICH OPERAND `fold` PUTS FIRST IN A PLUS

Measured in both directions on `func_800A0404`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04 -- 1 word
and 28 differing.

`&ARRAY[i]` is `TREE_CONSTANT`, so `fold` puts it SECOND in the PLUS and
`expand_expr`'s PLUS arm evaluates operand 0 first, which emits the `sll`
AHEAD of the `HIGH`/`LO_SUM`. `sched.py --sched2` confirms there is no
scheduling preference to appeal to: in basic block 6 the `ashift` (insn 106),
the `high` (107) and the `lo_sum` (108) are all **priority 1**, so the
tie-break is `INSN_LUID` and the order is the RTL order. reorg then finds the
`sll` as the join block's first insn, COPIES it into the branch's delay slot
and leaves the original -- a duplicated word that buys nothing: **42 words, 28
differing**.

Assigning the base from the symbol as a STATEMENT (`r = (u8 *)ARRAY;`) puts the
`HIGH` first. reorg takes the SHIFT LOOP's own `lui` off the fall-through
thread instead; the preheader is then left needing only its `addiu %lo`, and
the leftover `lui` covers the loop-exit predecessor: **41 words, 0 differing.**

The code to read is `reorg.c`'s thread choice --

```c
      if (prediction > 0)
	{
	  delay_list
	    = fill_slots_from_thread (insn, condition, insn_at_target,
				      fallthrough_insn, prediction == 2, 1,
				      own_target, own_fallthrough,
				      slots_to_fill, &slots_filled);
```

-- and the scan loop that keeps going on a thread it owns:

```c
  for (trial = thread;
       ! stop_search_p (trial, ! thread_if_true) && (! lose || own_thread);
       trial = next_nonnote_insn (trial))
```

**Stated limit:** the agent read the thread choice and the loop condition and
verified the OBSERVABLE in both directions -- which insn lands in the delay
slot, which block keeps a `lui` -- but did NOT instrument `mostly_true_jump`.
Whether reorg preferred the fall-through or tried the taken thread and failed
is not established. Treat the citation as where to look and the two
measurements as the evidence.

A draft that the same agent's own measurement falsified, recorded as a
non-cause: the shared `lui` is NOT one `HIGH` pseudo rematerialised by reload
through `reg_equiv_constant`. The preheader's `addiu $v0, $v0, %lo` reads a
`$v0` that only the delay slot sets, and no definition dominates both the
preheader and the join -- `$v0` holds the compare's constant immediately
before the branch and is clobbered inside the loop. It is reorg's steal plus a
leftover copy.

## AN ODD `%hi`/`%lo` COUNT ON ONE FUNCTION SYMBOL IS reorg COPYING THE `lui`, NOT A SECOND INSTALL

Not a lever but a reading rule, and it retires a worry: it is unreachable from
C, so there is nothing to try.

Measured on `func_800A75E4`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04. It carries
`%hi(func_800A76F0)` **twice** and `%lo(func_800A76F0)` once -- three
address-take words for one symbol, which reads like a second installer and is
not. The inner `beqz`'s target thread is also the OUTER `beqz`'s
fall-through, so the inner branch does not OWN that thread, and
`fill_slots_from_thread` copies the insn into the delay slot instead of moving
it:

> `scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/reorg.c:3637`
> ```c
> 		  temp = own_thread ? trial : copy_rtx (trial);
> ```

It then manufactures a label after the original and retargets the branch past
it (`:3829` `label = get_label_before (new_thread);`, `:3831`
`reorg_redirect_jump (insn, label);`). The listing shows exactly that shape:

```
    beqz       $v0, .L800A7648
     lui       $a2, %hi(func_800A76F0)      # reorg's COPY, in the delay slot
    ...
  .L800A7644:
    lui        $a2, %hi(func_800A76F0)      # the original
  .L800A7648:
    addiu      $a2, $a2, %lo(func_800A76F0)
```

Consequences for reading a brief's verified table and `seqcheck`'s output:

* An odd address-take count is normal, and the count is `%hi`/`%lo`
  OCCURRENCES, never (install targets x 2) -- which is why it is counted that
  way.
* **Do not pair the two `%hi`s as two installers of one handler.** That bogus
  pairing has already gone into a brief as its strongest lead once (from the
  install-versus-test confusion) and cost an agent a detour.
* Nothing in the source controls it. It falls out of the branch structure, so
  a candidate that reproduces the branches reproduces the duplicate.

## sched1 DEFERS A SINGLE-ASSIGNMENT PSEUDO'S DEFINITION TO THE LATEST POINT IN ITS BLOCK, WHICH PUTS THE WRONG INSN IN A `jal`'s DELAY SLOT

Measured on `func_8008CC90`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04: **27 of 94 words**, with the
word count unchanged. No existing lever predicts it, because the mover is
sched1's *priority*, not a block boundary or reorg's window.

`adjust_priority` (`scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/sched.c:2551`) runs on sched1
only -- `if (reload_completed == 0)` at `:2554-2556`, and `birthing_insn_p`
itself returns 0 after reload at `:2517-2518`. Its `n_deaths` switch is dead by
gcc's own admission in the comment above it, so **case 0 is always taken**
(`:2582-2589`), and `birthing_insn_p` reduces to one test:

```c
      if (bb_live_regs[offset] & bit)
	return (reg_n_sets[i] == 1);
```
(`:2533-2534`). The block is scheduled **backward**, so a boosted definition
is placed as *late* as it can go -- the stated intent at `:2567-2568`, to
shorten the live range.

Consequence: with six fresh single-set locals, each of four `andi` result masks
is boosted past the *next* call's argument setup, so reorg finds the `andi`
immediately before the `jal` and parks it in the delay slot instead of the
arg-setup insn. Three delay slots wrong, 27 differing. Writing the values back
into an existing variable takes `reg_n_sets` to 2 and kills the boost.

**Fingerprint: a wrong `jal` delay slot holding the PREVIOUS call's result
mask, with the arg-setup insn displaced by one.**

**The rule is per-variable, and a uniform application of it is wrong.** On the
same function three variables need the boost removed and three need it kept: a
multiply-set counter drags its dependent computations out of order (14, 19 and
25 differing for the three uniform spellings) while fresh single-set ones stay
in place. The tool that finds it is `sched.py --sched1`, whose ready-list dump
prints the literal priority (`LAUNCH_PRIORITY` magnitude against 1); **the
sched2 dump shows every priority as 1 and is a dead end for this class**,
exactly because `adjust_priority` is a no-op after reload.

## A NEAR-`INT_MIN` CLAMP IS A `MAX_EXPR`, AND ITS OPERAND ORDER IS A SOURCE-VISIBLE FACT WORTH 16 WORDS

Measured on `func_80095094`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04, over thirteen spellings.

`fold` turns `A op B ? A : B` into a `MAX_EXPR` for GE/GT
(`scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/fold-const.c:5499`, built at `:5523`). The
expansion stores **operand 0** into the target and only then compares and
conditionally moves operand 1 (`expr.c:6386-6387`, followed by
`if (target != op0) emit_move_insn (target, op0);`).

So `MAX_EXPR(field, C)` loads the field straight into the destination, while
`MAX_EXPR(C, field)` materialises the **constant** first and overwrites it.
The second is reachable only when the constant is the comparison's FIRST
operand *and* the arms are written `C : field` -- `C >= f ? C : f` and
`f <= C ? C : f` are 0 differing, `f > C ? f : C` and `C < f ? f : C` are 16.

**The predicate's STRICTNESS picks which fold arm you land on.** Non-strict
reaches `MAX_EXPR` through `:5499` and is 0; **strict is 4 differing**, because
it arrives through `fold-const.c:5567` (*"If C1 is C2 - 1, this is
max(A, C2)"*) with the other constant. A cheap discriminator: at the right
length with 4 differing around an `slt` on a near-`INT_MIN` constant, flip the
strictness before anything else.

**The `if/else` form does not care about strictness** (both spellings 0),
because that shape comes from jump.c rather than the MIN/MAX fold --
`expr.c:6804` carries the `#if 0`'d copy with the comment *"This is now done in
jump.c and is better done there because it produces shorter register
lifetimes"*. So four spellings reach 0 and they fall into two mechanisms.

**This also bounds the comparison-operand-order lever above**: `f > C` and
`C < f` measure IDENTICALLY here, because fold canonicalises a constant-first
comparison before the COND_EXPR ever sees it. That lever is real -- it paid 16
words on `func_80094DA8` -- but it does not transfer to a comparison with a
CONSTANT operand. What matters there is the ternary's ARM order.

## A POINTER LOCAL'S POSITION AMONG STATEMENTS DECIDES WHICH ALLOCATOR SEES IT, AND THE BOUNDARY IS THE BASIC BLOCK, NOT THE DECLARATION

The next refinement of the declaration-vs-statement lever above. Measured on
`func_800A5340`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04: **57 of 64 words**, and again on
`func_800A549C` (4 differing).

`func_800A5340` has three branch arms before the first use of its pointer.
With the assignment at the TOP, the pointer is referenced in more than one
basic block, so flow.c marks it global and global-alloc gives it a
callee-saved register with the `%hi` hoisted into the prologue -- 63 words, 57
differing. The same statement moved down, so the assignment and both uses sit
in ONE block, keeps `$v0` and is 0 differing.

> `scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/flow.c:2113-2116`
> ```c
> 	      if (reg_basic_block[regno] == REG_BLOCK_UNKNOWN)
> 		reg_basic_block[regno] = blocknum;
> 	      else if (reg_basic_block[regno] != blocknum)
> 		reg_basic_block[regno] = REG_BLOCK_GLOBAL;
> ```

`flow.c:167-168` explains the sentinel (*"If the value is REG_BLOCK_GLOBAL
(-2), it means (REG n) is used in more than one basic block"*), and the gate is
`local-alloc.c:470-472`, which hands a quantity only to pseudos with
`reg_basic_block[i] >= 0`.

So when a pointer local is a few words off and the `%hi` is in the prologue,
the question is not where it is DECLARED but how many blocks separate its
assignment from its uses.

## HOW MANY IDENTICAL `return CONST;` BODIES A FUNCTION HAS DECIDES WHICH COPY SURVIVES CROSS-JUMPING, AND THE SURVIVOR'S POSITION DECIDES EVERY OTHER BRANCH'S DELAY SLOT

Measured on `func_800B8834`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04. Word-count-neutral and
worth **11 to 59 differing**, and testable in one compile: count the identical
`return CONST` bodies and move one.

`do_cross_jump` (`scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/jump.c:2758`) redirects the jump
it is *processing* and deletes **that jump's own** preceding copy (`:2784`,
`:2790-2804`), so the copy found by walking `jump_chain` (`:2193-2203`)
survives and `insn`'s dies.

`func_800B8834` has six identical `addu $v0, $zero, $zero` + return bodies.
With three separate guard `if`s the survivor lands at the last guard, where it
becomes that branch's **fall-through** -- so the branch cannot steal its
`$v0 = 0` into the delay slot, a `lui` goes there instead, and the loop's own
copy dies: 99 words, 59 differing, with two words missing from inside the loop.
Joining two guards with `||` removes one copy, the loop's becomes the survivor,
and every other branch gets its `$v0 = 0` back: 100 words, 0 differing. Same
lever inside the loop, same direction: `||` is 0 and two `if`s is 11.

Two non-causes, both falsified by measurement on this function: it is **not**
reorg's delay-slot choice (reorg had the same two candidates either way), and
the `||`-versus-two-`if`s question inside the loop measures 0-against-11 only
once the surrounding structure is right -- measured while it was still broken,
both spellings read 99/72, which is how a real lever can look like no lever.

## CORRECTION: abssi2's THREE-WORD FORM EMITS ITS OWN DELAY SLOT; reorg DOES NOT STEAL THE `move`

A correction to the `abs()` entry above. The `move` in the different-register
arm is inside the pattern's own `.set noreorder` block:

> `scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/config/mips/mips.md:1766-1788`
> ```
>     return "%(bgez\t%1,1f\n\tmove\t%0,%1\n\tsubu\t%0,%z2,%0\n1:%)";
> ```

`%(` and `%)` are `.set noreorder` / `.set reorder`, so the `move` **is** the
delay slot by construction, and `subu %0,%z2,%0` is what splat prints as
`negu`. The `REGNO (operands[0]) == REGNO (operands[1])` test at `:1776` is
unaffected: the two-word in-place form still happens exactly when the source
dies at the abs. Only the attribution of the third word was wrong.

## CORRECTION: AN EXPLICIT `(u8 *)` CAST DOES NOT BLOCK `pointer_int_sum`'s REWRITE -- A POINTER LOCAL DOES

A refinement of the `pointer_int_sum` entry above, measured on `func_800B98B4`,
ovl_town, 2026-11-04. `*((u8 *)&ARRAY[e][0] + 1)` still gets the distributive
rewrite: two related bases (`addiu $s4, $v0, 1` with `addiu $s3, $s4, -1`
derived off it), a fifth saved register, **60 words / 53 differing** against
57 / 0 for a `u8 *` local assigned as a statement. So the cast is not an
escape; hoisting the base into a pointer local is.

## `&&` IS LEFT-ASSOCIATIVE, AND THAT HIDES A RANGE TEST FROM `fold`

Measured on `func_800AD914`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04: **3 words and 21 differing**,
and the fix is one pair of parentheses.

`p[1] != 0x17 && p[1] != 0x18` folds to `addiu $v0,$v1,-0x17` / `sltiu $v0,$v0,2`
-- two words. Written as **`A && B && C`** it does not fold at all: an `andi`
plus two `li`/`beq` pairs, 24 words and 21 differing with the register
assignment wrecked. Written **`A && (B && C)`** it folds: 21 words, 0
differing.

`fold`'s `TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR` arm calls the range optimizer on the node itself --
`scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/fold-const.c:4848-4850`:

```c
      /* See if we can build a range comparison.  */
      if (0 != (tem = fold_range_test (t)))
	return tem;
```

and `fold_range_test` only ever reads the node's **two immediate operands**
(`:3093-3094`):

```c
  tree lhs = make_range (TREE_OPERAND (exp, 0), &in0_p, &low0, &high0);
  tree rhs = make_range (TREE_OPERAND (exp, 1), &in1_p, &low1, &high1);
```

With left-associativity `A && B && C` is `(A && B) && C`, so operand 0 is
itself a `TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR`, `make_range` cannot turn it into a range, and the
B/C range is never built. The sibling path at `:4857-4859` *does* reach into
`arg0`'s rhs, but it calls `fold_truthop`, which merges **component
references** -- bitfield compares against one object -- not ranges, so it does
not recover the case.

**Rule: whenever two comparisons on the same operand sit at positions 2 and 3
of a `&&`/`||` chain, parenthesise them together.** A range test that is the
whole condition of its own `if` folds on the first try, because it is already
the top-level node.

## `fold`'s ADDITIVE-CONSTANT SWAP IS AN INVOLUTION, SO WRITE THE CONSTANT ON THE OPERAND THE LISTING DOES NOT HAVE IT ON

A correction to the DIRECTION of the reassociation levers above. Those are
written one-directionally, and one of them says flatly that parentheses and
operand order do not help. That is right for **pinning** a constant -- where a
temporary is indeed the only way -- but the rule underneath is that `fold`
always moves the additive constant to the **other** operand, so when the
listing has it on the operand you did not write it on, swapping which operand
carries it is the whole fix: one token, no temporary.

Both arms, measured on `func_800AE854`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04:

* **arg0 arm** -- `split_tree (arg0, ...)` at
  `scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/fold-const.c:4201`, rewrite at `:4234-4235`:
  ```c
		  /* Otherwise return VAR +- (ARG1 +- CON).  */
		  tem = fold (build (code, type, arg1, con));
		  t = build (code, type, var, tem);
  ```
  `(VAR + CON) + ARG1` becomes `VAR + (ARG1 + CON)`. So `row*0x10 + 0xA +
  quotient` puts the `addiu $v0, $v0, 0xA` on the **quotient**. 210 words,
  **0 differing**.
* **arg1 arm** -- `split_tree (arg1, ...)` at `:4258`, rewrite at `:4277-4278`:
  ```c
	      t = build (TREE_CODE (t), type,
			 fold (build (code, TREE_TYPE (t), arg0, con)), var);
  ```
  `ARG0 + (CON + VAR)` becomes `(ARG0 + CON) + VAR`. So `row*0x10 + (quotient
  + 0xA)` puts the `addiu` on the **row** term -- and the freed `addiu` then
  fits the load-delay slot the target fills with a `nop`. **209 words, 191
  differing.**

**That second half is the part worth remembering: a one-word LENGTH residue
can be an association rather than a missing instruction.** It does not look
like a reassociation defect from the outside.

## `split_tree` MATCHES ONLY THE OPERATOR BEING FOLDED, SO `<< k` BLOCKS MULT REASSOCIATION WHERE `* (1 << k)` DOES NOT

Measured on `func_800AE854`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04: 13 differing with the
addition already right, 201 with it wrong.

`split_tree` is entered only under
`scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/fold-const.c:1008-1012`:

```c
  if (TREE_CODE (in) == code
      || (! FLOAT_TYPE_P (TREE_TYPE (in))
	  /* We can associate addition and subtraction together ... */
	  && ((code == PLUS_EXPR && TREE_CODE (in) == MINUS_EXPR)
```

so for `code == MULT_EXPR` **only a MULT_EXPR matches**. `D * (frame * 0x10)`
therefore splits arg1 and `:4277-4278` rebuilds it as `(D * 0x10) * frame` --
an `sll` on the row DIFFERENCE and a `mult` by the frame, where the target
shifts the frame and multiplies by the difference. An `LSHIFT_EXPR` can never
match, so `(frame << 4)` keeps the grouping.

**Cross-reference, because the surface is identical and the rule points the
other way:** the `<< k`-versus-`* (1 << k)` lever above is about mask
propagation into a sign-extending load on a narrowing store, and there
`* (1 << k)` is the safe spelling. Same two spellings, two different
mechanisms, opposite verdicts -- so decide which mechanism is in play before
reaching for either.

## CORRECTION: TRY THE DECLARATION LEVER BEFORE THE BLOCK-COUNT ESCALATION WHEN A LEAF'S RESIDUE IS A PURE RENAME

The escalation advice above -- when a small leaf comes out word-exact with
only register names differing and no spelling moves it, vary the BASIC-BLOCK
COUNT -- is right as a last resort and wrong as a first move.

Measured on `func_800AD7F8`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04. It presented exactly that
fingerprint: 12 of 12 words, 5 differing, every one a register rename plus one
`addu` operand-order flip (`addu $v1,$v1,$v0` against `addu $a0,$v0,$v1`). The
block count was **not** the answer. Removing the pointer local was: with the
local, the pointer gets its own pseudo that local-alloc puts in `$v1` and the
loaded byte lands in `$a0`; written inline twice, cse leaves the address in
`$a0` (the parameter's register, dead after the two loads) and the byte in
`$v1`, and the `addu` comes out index-first. One measurement against an
open-ended search.

So the order is: the declaration lever (where a variable is declared decides
which allocator sees it), then its position among statements (the basic-block
boundary lever above), and only then the block count.

## THE abs TERNARY'S ARM ORDER DECIDES WHETHER `fold` PRODUCES `ABS_EXPR` AT ALL -- A SEPARATE VARIABLE IS NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT

This refines the ALWAYS-list rule that `expand_abs`'s copy survives only when a
ternary writes a SEPARATE variable, and it supplies the mechanism for the
earlier empirical note that `t < 0 ? -t : t` does not fold while
`t >= 0 ? t : -t` does.

The guard is `scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/fold-const.c:5459-5465`:

```c
	  /* If we have A op 0 ? A : -A, this is A, -A, abs (A), or abs (-A),
	     depending on the comparison operation.  */
	  if ((FLOAT_TYPE_P (TREE_TYPE (TREE_OPERAND (arg0, 1)))
	       ? real_zerop (TREE_OPERAND (arg0, 1))
	       : integer_zerop (TREE_OPERAND (arg0, 1)))
	      && TREE_CODE (arg2) == NEGATE_EXPR
	      && operand_equal_p (TREE_OPERAND (arg2, 0), arg1, 0))
```

So the NEGATE must be the **third** operand -- the `else` arm. `GE_EXPR` and
`GT_EXPR` then return an `ABS_EXPR` (`:5473-5478`); `LE_EXPR` and `LT_EXPR`
return the NEGATE of one (`:5479-5485`).

Measured on `func_800B3B18`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04, three abs sites, **8
differing to 0**:

* `d >= 0 ? d : -d` -- arg2 is a NEGATE_EXPR, the guard passes, `ABS_EXPR`,
  and `expand_abs` moves to the target and negates **in place**: the target's
  `negu $v0, $v0`.
* `d < 0 ? -d : d` -- arg2 is plain `d`, the guard FAILS, nothing folds, and
  the COND_EXPR's arm negates the **source**: `negu $v0, $v1`. One word per
  site.

`e = d; if (e < 0) e = -e;` measures the same as the failing ternary, so the
rule is about reaching `ABS_EXPR`, not about the statement form.

## SHARING ONE LOCAL ACROSS REPEATED BLOCKS LETS THE SIGNED DIVIDE'S COPY BE PROPAGATED AWAY -- AND ONLY IN THE BLOCKS THAT ARE NOT LAST

Measured on `func_800B3B18`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04: **4 words per block, 8
differing**, across three structurally identical blocks.

A signed divide by a power of two compares the `copy_to_mode_reg` COPY, not the
original (`scratch/gcc-src/cdk-gcc-b18/expmed.c:3021-3022`):

```c
      t1 = copy_to_mode_reg (compute_mode, op0);
      emit_cmp_insn (t1, const0_rtx, GE, NULL_RTX, compute_mode, 0, 0);
```

so the target reads `bgez $v0` with the copy before it. With ONE shared
local pair across the three blocks, blocks 1 and 2 get the copy propagated
into both the `bgez` and the `addiu` (`bgez $v1`, `addiu $v0,$v1,3`), the
now-partially-dead copy sinks into the `bgez`'s delay slot, and a `nop` is
left in the `bnez`'s. Separate locals per block fix all of it.

**Block 3 is unaffected either way, and that asymmetry is the diagnostic**: it
is the shared pseudo's live range reaching BACK across the earlier blocks that
does it. Fingerprint: a repeated-block function whose LAST block is exact and
whose earlier ones are each off by a delay-slot or operand shuffle.

## AN INLINE `memcpy`'s ALIGNMENT IS DECIDED BY THE SOURCE DECLARATION ALONE

A correction of emphasis to the `move_by_pieces` notes above, which state the
`MIN(src_align, dst_align)` rule but read as though both sides needed
alignment 1.

Measured on `func_800B3D04`, ovl_town, 2026-11-04. With `extern u8 X[]` as the
source, the unaligned `lwl`/`lwr` + `swl`/`swr` pair survives **even when the
destination is a 4-aligned `s32 c[4]`** -- 32 words / 0 differing, identical to
a `u8 c[0x10]` destination. Declaring the SOURCE `extern u32 X[]` instead is
24 words / 29 differing.

So when an inline block move is the residue, the lever is the source
declaration; the destination's declared type is free and can be whatever
documents the record.
